semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides scrap materials that are used in semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in prototyping and testing.
summary: Takimoto Giken Industry specializes in supplying scrap materials like polypropylene and MC nylon to semiconductor companies facing supply chain challenges. These materials are used for prototyping, jigs, simple processing, and in-house testing, offering cost-effective solutions during periods of supply instability.
capabilities: Supply of polypropylene and MC nylon scrap materials
Provision of materials for prototyping and testing applications
